paper.title: Little Red Dots: Rapidly Growing Black Holes Reddened by Extended Dusty Flows

result.summary: 本文针对JWST发现的小红点（LRDs）的V形光谱能量分布（SED）提出一个从静止系紫外到红外的SED模型，假设典型AGN的入射辐射被一个延展的尘埃介质所包裹，其消光律类似于猎户座星云或某些AGN环境 [S1.p6][S5.p2]。模型用灰消光曲线解释紫外过剩和光学红连续谱，无需额外恒星辐射或AGN散射光 [S2.p6][S5.p2]。在红外波段，延展且密度集中度较低的尘埃气体分布（γ<1）使较冷尘埃主导辐射，将能量峰值从近红外移到中红外，从而产生与JWST MIRI观测一致的SED变平 [S3.p2][S5.p2]。作者据此讨论了LRDs在z>4的出现、V形SED的普遍性以及早期黑洞宇宙学演化等开放问题 [S1.p6]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的核心问题是LRDs特征性V形SED的起源，即静止系光学红连续谱（≳4000 Å）与紫外蓝/平坦过剩分别来自尘埃遮蔽AGN、星暴星系还是散射光 [S1.p2]。作者指出，MIRI观测显示多数LRDs在F1800W未被探测到，且探测到的源其SED从静止系光学到近红外趋于变平，这似乎与热尘埃再发射导致光学到近红外都很红的预期相矛盾，从而引发对尘埃遮蔽AGN情景的质疑 [S1.p3]。此外，LRDs在λ≳1 μm处SED多样性的原因尚不清楚 [S1.p3]。

evidence.quote: Despite their significance, the properties of these newly identified LRDs remain puzzling, particularly concerning the origin of their characteristic v-shaped spectral energy distribution (SED).

Observational studies using SED template fitting suggested that the red optical part could either be due to dust-reddened AGNs or starburst galaxies, while the blue UV component might represent light from unobscured galaxies or scattered light from embedded AGNs.
Those observations appear to contradict expectations that the SED should be very red throughout the optical to NIR spectrum due to re-emission from hot dust components heated by the AGNs.
While a certain fraction of LRDs show extremely red SEDs from NIR to mid-infrared (MIR), the reasons for such diversity at $\lambda\gtrsim 1~\mu\mathrm{m}$ are not well understood.

method.text: 论文提出一个LRDs的SED模型：假设典型AGN的入射辐射被延展尘埃介质包裹，采用类似猎户座星云或某些AGN环境的消光律，用灰消光在λ<3000 Å产生平坦紫外谱，在λ>4000 Å产生红色光学连续谱，无需额外恒星辐射或AGN散射光 [S1.p6][S2.p6]。红外部分用径向密度分布ρ=ρ0(r/rin)^(-γ)描述延展尘埃气体，通过平衡尘埃加热与热发射冷却计算尘埃温度，并计算尘埃再发射光度 [S3.p3][S3.p4]。模型还考虑辐射压反馈，将亚毫米半径rin替换为光学厚度为1的光球半径rph，使热尘埃被推到更大半径而变冷，从而把近红外发射移到中红外 [S3.p5]。

evidence.quote: We hypothesize that the incident radiation from an AGN, characterized by a typical SED, is embedded in an extended dusty medium with an extinction law similar to those seen in dense regions such as Orion Nebula or certain AGN environments.
There is no need for additional stellar emission or AGN scattered light.

Our findings in this work further demonstrate that such gray extinction curves can explain the characteristic v-shaped SEDs of LRDs, as evidenced by accumulated large samples, without considering multiple components such as host galaxies or scattered AGN light.
we focus not only on a compact dust structure such as a dust torus, but rather a more extended dust structure described by a radial density profile of $\rho=\rho_{0}(r/r_{\rm in})^{-\gamma}$
In our model, feedback effects are incorporated by substituting $r_{\rm in}$ with $r_{\rm ph}$ in Equation ( 3).
As a result of the feedback, hot dust just behind the sublimation radius $r_{\rm in}$ is pushed to larger radii and becomes cooler, shifting the NIR emission to MIR.

experiments.text: 论文将模型SED与LRDs的堆叠测光数据比较，包括z~5.5和z=7.5的样本，以及JADES和COSMOS-Web巡天的堆叠数据 [S2.p5][S3.p6]。模型采用AV=3 mag、Lbol=10^46 erg/s等参数，并叠加JWST各巡天（COSMOS-Web、CEERS、JADES-Medium/Deep）的5σ点源成像深度进行比较 [S2.p9]。红外部分还叠加了SCUBA和ALMA未探测给出的中远红外通量上限，并扫描气体密度n0（1–10^3 cm^-3）和密度斜率γ（0、1、2）等参数 [S3.p6][S3.p7][S3.p10]。

evidence.quote: As reference, we overlay photometric SED data obtained from stacking LRD samples at $z\sim 5.5$ (orange) and $z=7.5$ (blue).
For comparison, we overlay the stacking photometric data of observed LRDs reported by the JADES survey and the COSMOS-Web survey.
Furthermore, the upper bounds of the mid- to far-IR flux densities due to non-detection in SCUBA and ALMA bands are shown (triangles,; see also).
For comparison, we overlay the $5~\sigma$ point-source imaging depths for each NIRCam broadband filter used in several JWST survey programs.

In the left panel of Figure 4, we show the dependence of the SED shape on the gas density ( $1\leq n_{0}/{\rm cm}^{-3}\leq 10^{3}$) at the sublimation radius, while the slope of its radial profile is fixed to $\gamma=0$.
The right panel of Figure 4 presents cases for a centrally concentrated density distribution with $\gamma=2$ and $\gamma=1$, alongside the case of $\gamma=0$ and $n_{0}=100~{\rm cm}^{-3}$

findings.text: 采用猎户座星云和AGN复合谱消光律的模型能产生LRDs特征的V形SED，紫外斜率βUV~-2，而其他消光律无法维持紫外过剩 [S2.p5]。在红外，当密度集中（γ=1–2）或n0≳10^3 cm^-3时，热尘埃导致近红外过亮，与MIRI数据不符；而较低密度（n0=10–100 cm^-3）使较冷尘埃主导，能量峰值移到中远红外，SED变平，与观测一致 [S3.p7][S3.p8][S3.p10]。满足AV≈3 mag、βopt/NIR<-1和Tout≥30 K的允许参数空间约为10^(2.9γ+0.83)≲n0/cm^-3≲10^3（γ<0.8） [S4.SS1.p4]。模型估计的尘埃质量约1.2–9.6×10^4 M⊙与NIRCam图像估计一致 [S4.SS1.p6]。

evidence.quote: Models with extinction laws observed in the Orion Nebula and AGN composite spectra flatten the SED with a UV slope of $\beta_{\rm UV}\sim-2$.
In contrast, other models result in strongly attenuated flux that fails to maintain a UV excess.
However, this extremely red SED color does not match the JWST MIRI photometric data for LRDs, which suggest a modest red color or even a flat spectral shape.
The energy transfer from NIR to MIR significantly suppresses the NIR bump and eases the mismatch between our SED model and the JWST MIRI photometric data.

When the density is centrally concentrated with $\gamma=1-2$, a significant fraction of the obscuring material is efficiently heated by the AGN, and thus the hot dust just behind the sublimation radius is responsible for the IR emissivity.
Here, the density range is approximated as $10^{2.9\gamma+0.83}\lesssim n_{0}/({\rm cm}^{-3})\lesssim 10^{3},$ (5) which is valid $\gamma<0.8$.
These results agree well to the mean value of the dust mass $\langle M_{\rm dust}\rangle\simeq 1.6^{+4.8}_{-0.9}\times 10^{4}~M_{\odot}$ estimated using NIRCam images of LRDs.

limitations.text: 作者承认，LRDs为何在z>4以统一的AV=3 mag出现，目前没有明确答案，只能给出一些推测 [S4.SS4.p1]。模型假设全天覆盖（C=1），但该值需在LRDs与未遮蔽AGN的相对宇宙丰度及C对AGN性质（如Eddington比）的依赖被更好理解后才能确定 [S3.p4]。关于尘埃散射导致变异性减弱的情景，作者表示更详细的定量分析将在未来工作中探索 [S4.SS3.p2]。此外，F1800W上限来自覆盖不到20% LRD样本的堆叠图像，需要更多静止系中红外波段研究 [S3.p9]。

evidence.quote: There is no clear answer to this question at this time, but some speculations are given below.

In our calculation, we assume a full-sky covering case (i.e., $C\equiv\Omega/4\pi=1$), while this value will be determined when the relative cosmic abundance between LRDs and unobscured AGNs and the dependence of $C$ on the AGN properties such as the Eddington ratio are better understood for LRDs.
A more detailed quantitative analysis of this scenario will be explored in future work.
It is important to note that the F1800W upper limit is derived from stacking images covering less than 20% of the LRD samples observed with the F770W MIRI filter.
